steps: Facade first routes every capability to the legacy system.
One bounded capability is implemented and verified in the new service.
Routing moves only that capability while legacy handles the rest.
More slices migrate until legacy dependencies and traffic reach zero.

lesson.scenario: An insurance monolith yields quote traffic to a replacement service one capability and cohort at a time.
